name: Kulkilo
backstory: Originally from Tyrnea. Keeps a little stall next to the bridge, selling fish.

items: inhabitant: Saltamontabiras (cross-locality travelers/routes (named, with a mode of travel))

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only if the stall's still there for whoever wants to take it over from him
criterion.wasted_life: one spent working a stall that dies with him, same as if he'd never kept it at all
criterion.trusts: a catch he's weighed himself, not what a buyer swears it weighs
criterion.distrusts: a price that changes depending on who's asking

routines.routine_actions: lays out the morning catch at the bridge-side stall, haggles hard but fair, packs up whatever's left before it turns
walks the bridge crossing between customers, trading nods with Tresno and whoever else works the same stretch
trades the day's odd catch for a drink more often than he sells it, keeps half an ear on who's buying

arc.premise: Kulkilo wants to take on a real apprentice for the stall - someone who'll actually still be selling fish off that same spot by the bridge after he's gone, not just a nephew helping out for a season. Resolution: someone sticks with it a full year and the stall passes on when it needs to, or nobody does and the spot goes to whoever else wants it when he's done.
